fact: The commerce ministry's National MSME Policy 2024-2029 provides for a start-up matching fund and a review of tax requirements for start-ups, and sets Cabinet adoption as its last step.
The commerce ministry reports that the E45 million MSME Revolving Fund, run by Eswatini Bank since February 2021 for firms hit by COVID-19 and for start-ups, had lent E54.5 million by September 2024.
